findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/hooks-ensure.js::unbounded matcher string compiled as a regex in fencecoversbash
findings.title: Unbounded matcher string compiled as a regex in fenceCoversBash
findings.action: Cap matcher length before compiling, or accept the local-file trust boundary
findings.disposition_rationale: The matcher comes from the operator's own settings file, the same string Claude Code compiles to decide whether the hook fires. The subject is the fixed four-character string Bash, so backtracking is bounded, and a length cap would make doctor disagree with Claude Code on a long but valid matcher. A bad pattern already falls through to not-firing.

occurrences.title: Unbounded matcher string compiled as a regex in fenceCoversBash

findings.title: Exists-then-read race in readHookSettingsFile reads a removed file as invalid
findings.action: Treat ENOENT on the read as absent
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed in 202334f8: the existsSync pre-check is gone and ENOENT on the read returns the absent state; a directory at the path still reads as cannot read file (EISDIR).
